---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Summary

A brief description of the feature and its value.

## Motivation

Why is this needed? What problem does it solve? What use case does it enable?

## Proposed Design

(Optional) Any thoughts on how this might be implemented. Include references to relevant IRs, dialects, or passes if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why are they inferior to this proposal?

## Impact Assessment

- Does this affect the core/plugin boundary? (yes / no)
- Does this require an RFC? (yes if it modifies the IR schema, plugin API, or cross-crate public API)
- Estimated complexity: (small / medium / large / unknown)
